description: This file defines data structures and functions for a string-based map, set, and int map implementation in C, including initialization, manipulation, and traversal operations.

classes.name: strmap
classes.description: A structure representing a map from strings to void pointers, utilizing an internal hashmap for storage and a memory pool for allocations.

classes.name: strmap_entry
classes.description: A structure representing an individual entry within a strmap, associating a key string with a data pointer.

classes.name: strintmap
classes.description: A map from strings to integers, built on top of strmap, with a default value for missing keys.

classes.name: strset
classes.description: A set of strings implemented as a special case of strmap where the values are ignored.

methods.name: cmp_strmap_entry
methods.description: Comparison function for strmap entries used for hashing and equality checks.

methods.name: strmap_init
methods.description: Initializes a strmap, managing memory and settings.

methods.name: strmap_init_with_options
methods.description: Initializes a strmap with specific memory pool and string duplication options.

methods.name: strmap_clear
methods.description: Clears all entries from the strmap, optionally freeing values.

methods.name: strmap_partial_clear
methods.description: Clears the strmap while keeping the internal table allocated; used for reinitializations.

methods.name: strmap_put
methods.description: Inserts or updates an entry in the strmap with a key and data.

methods.name: strmap_get_entry
methods.description: Retrieves the internal entry associated with a key.

methods.name: strmap_get
methods.description: Returns the data pointer associated with a key.

methods.name: strmap_contains
methods.description: Checks whether a key exists in the strmap.

methods.name: strmap_remove
methods.description: Removes a key and its associated data from the strmap.

methods.name: unsigned int strmap_get_size(struct strmap * map)
methods.description: Returns the number of entries in the strmap.

methods.name: int strmap_empty(struct strmap * map)
methods.description: Checks whether the strmap is empty.

methods.name: strmap_for_each_entry
methods.description: Iterates over each entry in the strmap.

methods.name: void strintmap_init(struct strintmap * map,int default_value)
methods.description: Initializes a strintmap with a default integer value.

methods.name: void strintmap_init_with_options(struct strintmap * map,int default_value,struct mem_pool * pool,int strdup_strings)
methods.description: Initializes a strintmap with specific options.

methods.name: void strintmap_clear(struct strintmap * map)
methods.description: Clears the strintmap.

methods.name: void strintmap_partial_clear(struct strintmap * map)
methods.description: Partially clears the strintmap, keeping internal structures allocated.

methods.name: int strintmap_contains(struct strintmap * map,const char * str)
methods.description: Checks if a string key exists in the strintmap.

methods.name: void strintmap_remove(struct strintmap * map,const char * str)
methods.description: Removes a key from the strintmap.

methods.name: int strintmap_get(struct strintmap * map,const char * str)
methods.description: Retrieves the integer value for a key, or default if not present.

methods.name: void strintmap_set(struct strintmap * map,const char * str,intptr_t v)
methods.description: Sets the integer value for a key.

methods.name: strintmap_incr
methods.description: Increments the value associated with a key by a specified amount.

methods.name: void strset_init(struct strset * set)
methods.description: Initializes an empty strset.

methods.name: void strset_init_with_options(struct strset * set,struct mem_pool * pool,int strdup_strings)
methods.description: Initializes a strset with specific options.

methods.name: void strset_clear(struct strset * set)
methods.description: Clears the strset.

methods.name: void strset_partial_clear(struct strset * set)
methods.description: Partially clears the strset.

methods.name: int strset_contains(struct strset * set,const char * str)
methods.description: Checks if a string is in the set.

methods.name: void strset_remove(struct strset * set,const char * str)
methods.description: Removes a string from the set.

methods.name: strset_add
methods.description: Adds a string to the set.
